params.added: True if added, false if removed.
params.addr: The address that was added or removed.
params.nonce: The monotonic nonce from WhitelistRegistry at the time of the update.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

setReactiveCallbackProxy(address).details: Only callable by the contract owner.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

onCallback(address,bool,uint256).notice: Called by the Reactive Network callback proxy when a whitelist         change is relayed from the origin chain.

reactiveCallbackProxy().notice: The Reactive Network callback proxy that is authorised to call onCallback().

setReactiveCallbackProxy(address).notice: Update the authorised reactive callback proxy.
